verses.text: Now e happen, as di crowd dey press am to hear God word, e dey stand by di lake of Gennesaret.
E see two boats dey stand by di lake, but di fishermen don leave dem, dey wash dem nets.
E enter one of di boats, wey be Simon own, ask am make e push am small from di land. E sit down teach di crowds from di boat.
When e finish to talk, e talk to Simon say, “Push go di deep water, and throw your nets make you catch fish.”
Simon answer am, “Master, we work all night, and we no catch anything; but because you talk am, I go throw di net.”
When dem do am, dem catch plenty fish, and dem net dey tear.
Dem wave hand to dem partners for di other boat make dem come help dem. Dem come, fill both boats, so tay dem begin sink.
But Simon Peter, when e see am, fall down for Jesus knees, dey talk say, “Leave me, because I be sinful man, Lord.”
Because amazement catch am and all di people wey dey with am, because of di fish wey dem catch;
and so too James and John, Zebedee sons, wey be Simon partners. Jesus talk to Simon say, “No fear. From now you go dey catch people alive.”
When dem bring dem boats reach land, dem leave everything, follow am.
E happen as e dey one of di towns, look, one man dey wey leprosy full im body. When e see Jesus, e fall face down, beg am, dey talk say, “Lord, if you want, you fit make me clean.”
E stretch out im hand, touch am, dey talk say, “I want. Be clean.” At once di leprosy leave am.
E warn am make e tell nobody, “But go your way, show yourself to di priest, and offer for your cleansing as Moses command, as testimony to dem.”
But di news about am spread more, and great crowds gather to hear, and to dey healed by am of dem sicknesses.
But e go di wilderness, pray.

E happen for one of those days, e dey teach; and Pharisees and teachers of di law dey sit there, wey come from every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. Di power of di Lord dey with am to heal dem.
Look, men bring one man wey paralyze on cot, and dem dey try bring am enter put before Jesus.
As dem no find way to bring am enter because of di crowd, dem go up di housetop, lower am with im cot through di tiles enter di middle before Jesus.
As e see dem faith, e talk to am say, “My friend, dem don forgive your sins.”
Di scribes and di Pharisees begin reason, dey talk say, “Who be this wey dey talk blasphemies? Who fit forgive sins except God alone?”
But Jesus know dem thoughts, answer dem, “Why una dey reason so for una heart?
Which one easy pass, to talk say, ‘Dem don forgive your sins;’ or to talk say, ‘Get up and waka’?
But make una know say di Son of Man get authority for earth to forgive sins,” e talk to di paralyzed man, “I dey tell you, get up, carry your cot, and go your house.”
At once e get up before dem, carry di thing wey e dey lie on, go im house, dey praise God.
Amazement catch all, and dem praise God. Fear full dem, dey talk say, “We don see strange things today.”
After these things e go out, see one tax collector wey im name na Levi dey sit for di tax office, and talk to am say, “Follow me!”
E leave everything, get up follow am.
Levi make big feast for am for im house. Big crowd of tax collectors and others dey sit for table with dem.
Di Pharisees and dem scribes dey grumble against im disciples, dey talk say, “Why una dey chop and drink with di tax collectors and sinners?”
Jesus answer dem, “Di people wey strong no need doctor, but di sick people need am.
I no come to call di righteous, but sinners so that dem repent.”
Dem talk to am say, “Why John disciples dey fast and pray plenty times, and di Pharisees disciples too, but yours dey chop and drink?”
E talk to dem say, “Una fit make di friends of di groom fast, while di groom dey with dem?
But days go come wey dem go take di groom away from dem. Den dem go fast for those days.”
E tell dem parable too. “Nobody dey cut piece from new cloth put for old cloth, if no be so e go tear di new, and di piece from di new no go match di old.
Nobody dey put new wine inside old wineskins, if no be so di new wine go burst di wineskins, e go spill, and di wineskins go spoil.
But dem must put new wine inside new wineskins, and both go dey safe.
Nobody wey don drink old wine dey want new at once, because e dey talk say, ‘Di old better.’”
Now e happen for di second Sabbath after di first, e dey pass through grain farms. Im disciples pluck di heads of grain, dey rub dem for dem hands, dey chop.
But some of di Pharisees talk say, “Why una dey do wetin law no allow for Sabbath day?”
Jesus answer dem, talk say, “Una never read even this, wetin David do when hunger catch am, e and di people wey dey with am;
how e enter God house, take di show bread chop, give di people wey dey with am too, wey no dey lawful for anybody to chop except di priests alone?”
E talk to dem say, “Di Son of Man na Lord of di Sabbath.”
E happen for another Sabbath say e enter di synagogue teach. One man dey there, and im right hand don dry.
Di scribes and di Pharisees dey watch am, to see if e go heal for Sabbath, so that dem go find accusation against am.
But e know dem thoughts; and e talk to di man wey im hand dry say, “Get up, stand for middle.” E get up stand.
Den Jesus talk to dem say, “I go ask una something: Di law allow person to do good for Sabbath, or to do harm? To save life, or to kill?”
E look dem all round, talk to di man say, “Stretch out your hand.” E do am, and im hand come well like di other one.
But dem full with rage, and dem dey talk to each other about wetin dem fit do to Jesus.
E happen for these days, say e go di mountain to pray, and e continue all night dey pray to God.
When day break, e call im disciples, and from dem e choose 12, wey e name apostles:
Simon, wey e name Peter; Andrew, im brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;
Matthew; Thomas; James, Alphaeus son; Simon wey dem dey call di Zealot;
Judas, James son; and Judas Iscariot, wey become traitor too.

E come down with dem, stand for level place, with crowd of im disciples, and great number of people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and di sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, wey come to hear am and to heal from dem diseases;
and di ones wey evil spirits dey trouble, and dem dey heal.
All di crowd dey try touch am, because power dey come out of am and heal dem all.
E lift up im eyes to im disciples, talk say, “Blessed be una wey poor, because God Kingdom na una own.
Blessed be una wey hungry now, because una go satisfy. Blessed be una wey dey cry now, because una go laugh.
Blessed be una when men hate una, and when dem separate una and mock una, and throw una name away as evil, for di Son of Man sake.
Rejoice for that day, jump for joy, because look, your reward great for heaven, because dem papa dem do di same thing to di prophets.
But sorrow dey for una wey rich, because una don receive una consolation.
Sorrow dey for una wey full now, because una go hungry. Sorrow dey for una wey dey laugh now, because una go mourn and cry.
Sorrow dey when all men talk good about una, because dem papa dem do di same thing to di false prophets.
But I dey tell una wey dey hear: love una enemies, do good to di people wey hate una,
bless di people wey curse una, and pray for di people wey dey mistreat una.
Anybody wey slap you for cheek, show am di other too; and anybody wey take your cloak, no hold your coat from am too.
Give everybody wey ask you, and anybody wey take your goods, no ask dem back.
As una like make people do to una, do exactly so to dem.
If una love di people wey love una, wetin credit be that for una? Because even sinners dey love di people wey love dem.
If una do good to di people wey do good to una, wetin credit be that for una? Because even sinners dey do di same.
If una lend to di people wey una hope to receive from, wetin credit be that for una? Even sinners dey lend to sinners, to receive back di same amount.
But love una enemies, do good, and lend, no expect anything back; and una reward go great, and una go be pikin dem of di Most High; because e dey kind to di people wey no dey thank and di evil ones.
So make una dey merciful, just as una Papa God dey merciful too.
No judge, and dem no go judge una. No condemn, and dem no go condemn una. Release people, and dem go release una.

Give, and dem go give una: good measure, wey dem press down, shake together, and e dey overflow, dem go put am inside una lap. Because di same measure wey una use measure, na di same dem go use measure una back.”
E tell dem parable. “Blind person fit guide blind person? Dem no go both fall inside pit?
Student no pass im teacher, but everybody wey don train well go be like im teacher.
Why you dey see di speck wey dey your brother eye, but you no dey notice di beam wey dey your own eye?

Or how you fit talk to your brother, ‘Brother, make I remove di speck wey dey your eye,’ when you no see di beam wey dey your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove di beam from your own eye, den you go fit see well to remove di speck wey dey your brother eye.
Because no good tree dey wey dey bear bad fruit; and no bad tree dey wey dey bear good fruit.
Because each tree dey known by im own fruit. Because people no dey pick figs from thorns, and dem no dey pick grapes from bramble bush.
Di good man dey bring out good from di good treasure of im heart, and di evil man dey bring out evil from di evil treasure of im heart, because from wetin full di heart, im mouth dey talk.
“Why una dey call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ but una no dey do wetin I talk?
Everybody wey come to me, hear my words, and do dem, I go show una who e be like.
E be like man wey dey build house, wey dig go deep, and lay foundation for di rock. When flood rise, di stream hit that house, and e no fit shake am, because dem found am for di rock.
But di one wey hear, and no do, na like man wey build house for di ground without foundation, wey di stream hit, and at once e fall, and di ruin of that house great.”
After e don finish to talk for di people ears, e enter Capernaum.
One centurion servant, wey e love, dey sick and e near death.
When e hear about Jesus, e send Jewish elders to am, dey beg am make e come save im servant.
When dem reach Jesus, dem beg am strongly, dey talk say, “E worthy make you do this for am,
because e love our nation, and na am build our synagogue for us.”
Jesus go with dem. When e don near di house, di centurion send friends to am, talk to am say, “Lord, no trouble yourself, because I no worthy make you enter under my roof.
So I no even think say I worthy to come to you; but talk di word, and my servant go heal.
Because I too na man wey dey under authority, wey get soldiers under me. I dey tell this one, ‘Go!’ and e dey go; and another, ‘Come!’ and e dey come; and my servant, ‘Do this,’ and e dey do am.”
When Jesus hear these things, e marvel for am, turn talk to di crowd wey dey follow am, “I dey tell una, I never find great faith like this, no, even for Israel.”
Di people wey dem send return go di house, find say di servant wey dey sick don well.
E happen soon after, say e go one town wey dem call Nain. Plenty of im disciples go with am, with big crowd.
Now as e near di gate of di town, look, dem dey carry one dead person out, di only son of im mama, and di mama na widow. Big crowd from di town dey with am.
When Lord see di woman, compassion move am for am, and e talk to am say, “No cry.”
E come near and touch di coffin, and di people wey carry am stand still. E talk say, “Young man, I dey tell you, get up!”
Di dead man sit up, begin talk. And e give am to im mama.
Fear catch all, and dem praise God, dey talk say, “Great prophet don rise among us!” and, “God don visit im people!”
This news about am go out for all Judea, and for all di region round.
John disciples tell am about all these things.
John call two of im disciples, send dem go Jesus, dey talk say, “Na you be di one wey dey come, or make we dey wait for another?”
When di men reach am, dem talk say, “John di Baptizer don send us to you, dey talk say, ‘Na you be di one wey dey come, or make we dey wait for another?’”
For that hour e heal plenty people of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and e give sight to plenty blind people.

Jesus answer dem, “Go tell John di things wey una don see and hear: di blind dey receive sight, di lame dey waka, di people wey get leprosy dey clean, di deaf dey hear, dem dey raise di dead, dem dey preach Good News to di poor.
Blessed be di person wey no stumble because of me.”
When John messengers don go, e begin talk to di crowds about John, “Wetin una go out go di wilderness to see? Reed wey wind dey shake?
But wetin una go out to see? Man wey wear soft clothes? Look, di people wey dress fine, and dey live for luxury, dey for kings palaces.
But wetin una go out to see? Prophet? Yes, I dey tell una, and e pass prophet.
Na am dem write about, ‘Look, I dey send my messenger go before your face, wey go prepare your way before you.’
“Because I dey tell una, among di people wey women born, no prophet dey greater than John di Baptizer, but di one wey small pass for God Kingdom greater pass am.”
When all di people and di tax collectors hear this, dem agree say God dey just, as dem don baptize with John baptism.
But di Pharisees and di lawyers reject God plan for dem, as John no baptize dem.
Lord talk say, “To wetin I go compare di people of this generation? Wetin dem be like?
Dem be like pikin dem wey dey sit for di marketplace, dey call each other, dey talk say, ‘We play flute for una, una no dance. We mourn, una no cry.’
Because John di Baptizer come, no dey chop bread or drink wine, and una dey talk say, ‘Evil spirit dey inside am.’
Di Son of Man don come dey chop and drink, and una dey talk say, ‘Look, man wey dey eat too much, and drunkard; friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
Wisdom dey proved right by all im pikin dem.”
One of di Pharisees invite am to chop with am. E enter di Pharisee house, sit for table.
Look, one woman for di town wey be sinner, when e know say e dey sit for table for di Pharisee house, e bring alabaster jar of ointment.
Di woman stand behind for im feet, dey cry, begin wet im feet with im tears, wipe dem with im hair, kiss im feet, and anoint dem with di ointment.
Now when di Pharisee wey invite am see am, e talk for imself say, “This man, if e be prophet, e go know who and wetin kind woman this be wey dey touch am, say na sinner.”
Jesus answer am, “Simon, I get something to tell you.” E talk say, “Teacher, talk.”
“One lender get two debtors. One owe 500 denarii, and di other 50.
As dem no get wetin to pay, e forgive dem both. So which of dem go love am pass?”
Simon answer, “Di one, I think, wey e forgive pass.” E talk to am say, “You don judge correct.”
E turn to di woman, talk to Simon say, “You see this woman? I enter your house, you no give me water for my feet, but di woman don wet my feet with im tears, wipe dem with im hair.
You no give me kiss, but di woman, since di time wey I enter, no stop to kiss my feet.
You no anoint my head with oil, but di woman don anoint my feet with ointment.
So I dey tell you, im sins, wey plenty, dem don forgive, because e love plenty. But di person wey dem forgive small, na im dey love small.”
E talk to am say, “Dem don forgive your sins.”
Di people wey dey sit for table with am begin talk among demself, “Who be this wey even dey forgive sins?”
E talk to di woman, “Your faith don save you. Go in peace.”
E happen soon after, say e dey go round towns and villages, dey preach and dey bring Good News of God Kingdom, and di 12 dey with am,
and some women wey dem don heal from evil spirits and sicknesses: Mary wey dem dey call Magdalene, wey seven evil spirits don go out from am,
and Joanna, Chuza wife, Herod steward, and Susanna, and plenty others; wey dey serve dem from dem property.
When big crowd gather, and people from every town dey come to am, e talk with parable.
“Di farmer go out to plant im seed. As e dey plant, some fall by di road, and people waka on am, and birds of di sky chop am.
Other seed fall for rock, and as e grow, e dry, because e no get moisture.
Other fall among thorns, and di thorns grow with am, choke am.
Other fall for good ground, grow, and bear fruit 100 times.” As e talk these things, e shout, “Anybody wey get ears to hear, make e hear!”
Im disciples ask am, “Wetin this parable mean?”
E talk say, “Dem don give una to know di secrets of God Kingdom, but to di rest na parables, so that ‘as dem dey look, dem no go see, and as dem dey hear, dem no go understand.’
Now di parable be this: Di seed na God word.
Di ones for di road na di people wey hear, den di devil come, take di word from dem heart, so that dem no go believe and dey saved.
Di ones for di rock na di people wey, when dem hear, receive di word with joy; but these no get root, dem believe for small time, den fall away for time of temptation.
Wetin fall among thorns, na di people wey don hear, and as dem dey go dem way, worries, riches, and pleasures of life dey choke dem, and dem no bear fruit wey ripe.
Wetin for di good ground, na di people wey with honest and good heart, as dem don hear di word, dem hold am tight, and bear fruit with patience.
“Nobody, when e don light lamp, dey cover am with container, or put am under bed; but e dey put am on stand, so that di people wey enter go see di light.
Because nothing dey hidden wey dem no go reveal; and nothing dey secret wey dem no go know and come out for light.
So make una careful how una dey hear. Because anybody wey get, dem go give am more; and anybody wey no get, dem go take even wetin e think say e get.”
Im mama and im brothers come to am, and dem no fit come near am because of di crowd.
Some people tell am, “Your mama and your brothers dey stand outside, dem want see you.”
But e answer dem, “My mama and my brothers na these ones wey hear God word, and do am.”
Now e happen for one of those days, say e enter boat with im disciples, and e talk to dem say, “Make we cross go di other side of di lake.” So dem push out.
But as dem dey sail, e sleep. Wind storm come down on di lake, and water dey enter dem boat plenty, e dangerous.
Dem come to am, wake am up, dey talk say, “Master, Master, we dey die!” E wake up, rebuke di wind and di raging of di water, and dem stop, and calm come.
E talk to dem say, “Wia your faith dey?” Fear catch dem, dem marvel, dey talk to each other say, “Who then be this, wey even di winds and di water dey obey am when e command dem?”
Dem reach di country of di Gerasenes, wey dey opposite Galilee.
When e step out come land, one man from di town wey get evil spirits for long time meet am. E no dey wear cloth, and e no dey live for house, but for di tombs.
When e see Jesus, e shout, fall down before am, and with loud voice talk say, “Wetin I get to do with you, Jesus, Pikin of di Most High God? I beg you, no torment me!”

Because Jesus dey command di evil spirit to come out of di man. Because e don seize am plenty times. Dem dey guard am, tie am with chains and fetters; and e dey break di bands, di evil spirit dey drive am go di wilderness.
Jesus ask am, “Wetin be your name?” E talk say, “Legion,” because plenty evil spirits don enter am.
Dem beg am make e no command dem go di abyss.
One herd of plenty pigs dey there dey feed for di mountain, and dem beg am make e allow dem enter those ones. So e allow dem.
Di evil spirits come out from di man, enter di pigs, and di herd rush go down di steep bank enter di lake, and dem drown.
When di people wey dey feed dem see wetin happen, dem run, tell am for di town and for di country.
People go out to see wetin happen. Dem come to Jesus, find di man wey evil spirits don go out from, dey sit for Jesus feet, wear cloth, and e don get sense; and dem fear.
Di people wey see am tell dem how di man wey evil spirits control heal.
All di people of di country of di Gerasenes round beg am make e leave dem, because fear don catch dem well well. E enter di boat, return.
But di man wey evil spirits don go out from beg am make e fit go with am, but Jesus send am go, dey talk say,
“Return go your house, tell wetin great God don do for you.” E go im way, dey tell all di town wetin great Jesus don do for am.
E happen, when Jesus return, say di crowd welcome am, because dem all dey wait for am.
Look, one man come wey im name na Jairus, and e be ruler of di synagogue. E fall down for Jesus feet, beg am make e come im house,
because e get only daughter, about 12 years old, and e dey die. But as e dey go, di crowds dey press am.
One woman wey dey bleed for 12 years, wey don spend all im living on doctors, and nobody fit heal am,
come from behind am, touch di edge of im cloth; and at once di bleeding stop.
Jesus talk say, “Who touch me?” When all deny am, Peter and di people wey dey with am talk say, “Master, di crowds dey press you and dey push you, and you dey ask, ‘Who touch me?’”
But Jesus talk say, “Somebody touch me, because I know say power don go out of me.”
When di woman see say e no hide, e come dey shake, fall down before am, tell am before all di people why e touch am, and how e heal at once.
E talk to am say, “Daughter, take courage. Your faith don make you well. Go in peace.”
As e still dey talk, one person come from di synagogue ruler house, dey talk to am say, “Your daughter don die. No trouble di Teacher again.”
But Jesus hear am, answer am, “No fear. Just believe, and e go well.”
When e reach di house, e no allow anybody enter, except Peter, John, James, di pikin papa, and im mama.
All dey cry and mourn am, but e talk say, “No cry. E no die, e dey sleep.”
Dem dey laugh at am, as dem know say e don die.
But e hold im hand, call, dey talk say, “Pikin, get up!”
Im spirit return, and e get up at once. E command say make dem give am something to chop.
Im parents shock, but e warn dem make dem tell nobody wetin happen.
